newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisian Treasury raises 56 mln dinars at auction.
newsitem.headline: Tunisian Treasury raises 56 mln dinars at auction.

text.p: The Tunisian Treasury on Tuesday said it sold 56 million dinars of two-year notes at its weekly auction on Sept 24, repaying maturing paper totalling 51.2 million dinars.
The two-year notes payable in equal annual tranches were at a 9.000 percent yield, unchanged from last week's rate.
Banks bid for 109 million dinars for two, three, four and five-year notes at between 9.000 and 9.5 percent.
